text: {"lessons":["I should not let my purchase price decide whether to hold or sell; it is a reference point, not a reason to keep a stock.","Selling Stock D and Stock E at gains felt satisfying, but I should avoid taking profits just for that feeling when the investment case has not changed.","With prices unpredictable and no need to trade often, I should focus on diversification and a deliberate plan rather than reacting to short-term account swings."]}
